title: Zil Money Launches ZilRemit as Dedicated International Payment Platform | User | theeveningleader.com
text: TYLER, TX, USA - Oct 09, 2025 - Zil Money, a leading B2B payment platform, today announced the launch of ZilRemit, a dedicated platform for its international payment services. The new platform provides a focused identity for the company's high-speed, low-cost global payment solution, enabling businesses and individuals to send funds worldwide in minutes. ZilRemit operates as a dedicated platform exclusively for international payments, ensuring existing users experience a seamless transition with no changes to their accounts or workflows. Driven by significant enterprise demand, Zil Money has introduced ZilRemit as an independent platform for international payments. The service bypasses traditional correspondent banking networks through direct settlement infrastructure spanning the United Kingdom, France, Sweden, Germany, Estonia, Philippines, and India. This architecture eliminates intermediary bank fees and multi-day processing delays while providing transparent exchange rates without pre-funding requirements, addressing key barriers that have constrained cross-border business growth. “We’ve been overwhelmed by the positive response to our international payment feature, and it’s clear that our efforts to address the pain points of businesses are paying off,” said Sabeer Nelli, CEO of Zil Money Corporation. “The launch of ZilRemit as a dedicated platform reflects our continued commitment to providing businesses with a solution that simplifies cross-border payments, reduces costs, and enhances global collaboration.” The transition to ZilRemit will be seamless for existing users, with no changes to core functionality, accounts, or workflows. Customers will continue to enjoy the same level of robust support and secure, reliable infrastructure that has made Zil Money a trusted leader in B2B payments. Additionally, the ZilRemit app will enhance the user experience, providing even more efficient access to international payments, ensuring that businesses can manage transactions with greater ease and convenience. About Zil Money Corporation Zil Money is redefining business payments by delivering smart, efficient solutions for SMBs. As a leader in B2B payment innovation, Zil Money’s platform offers a comprehensive suite of tools that streamline financial operations, from check printing to ACH transfers, and cross-border payments. The platform is designed to simplify complex payment processes, reduce costs, and eliminate delays, allowing businesses to focus on what they do best. Trusted by over one million businesses globally, Zil Money continues to lead the charge in transforming how companies manage their finances.
